data.name: Dheemant
data.gender_notes: Dheemant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dheemant is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhi’ which means ‘intellect’ and ‘mant’ meaning ‘protection’. This name symbolizes a powerful and fearless individual, one who uses their intellect to protect and serve. The name Dheemant carries the meaning “Powerful, Fearless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dheemant usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with courage and wisdom, reflecting the inner strength and intelligence of the bearer.
data.etymology: Dheemant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dheemant total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
